title: Narrow gap in a wall line
description: Two Walls leave a 0.1-inch slit; the target stands in line with it.
basis: p. 30 partial line of sight (confirmed); sampling U2/U16
ruling: The two central rays pass through the slit and the two outer rays hit the walls: Partial. Neither wall touches the target, so there is no cover. Limitation: a real sliver of a wider target could be visible through a gap the fixed rays miss.
